text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wah, everyone came to watch...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Estimated 5 seconds until race start. 4, 
3, 2—

The gates open— and Mejiro McQueen bursts 
out.
Rewinding to the previous day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san, would you like to go watch the 
mock race being held on campus tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh, what...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It's a high-level, long-distance mock race 
featuring Umamusume who are active in 
Classic and Senior Year graded stakes 
races.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow, the top favorite to win the 
Tenno Sho (Spring), McQueen-san, will be 
running in this race."

(Mejiro McQueen—a graceful Umamusume with 
a strong sense of duty, carrying the 
Mejiro family on her shoulders.)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If our goal is "victory", reconnaissance 
is essential— I believe this inspection 
will be beneficial for Rice as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-Why with Rice...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...? That is—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I can't quite put it into words, but 
right now, I think I'm simply 'unable to 
sit still'â

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Because I deduced that Rice-san shares the 
exact same desire to 'win' the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).
(CLUNK)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Watched over by a crowd so large you 
wouldn't believe it's just a mock race, 
the competition begins right now!

text_block_list.name: McQueen Fan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Do your best! McQueen-san!

text_block_list.name: McQueen Fan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san will be fine! She's 
definitely, absolutely going to win...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Based on the fervor of the cheers, I 
confirm she has exceptionally high 
popularity."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And the front pack rounds the bend, 
approaching the fourth corner!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Who will be the first to make a move—?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

"Leaping into the lead, she widened the 
gap from second place in the blink of an 
eye—"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhh—!

Showing off overwhelming strength, she 
dove across the finish line.

text_block_list.name: McQueen Fan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Winning by more than seven lengths against 
that lineup—truly impressive, McQueen-san!

text_block_list.name: McQueen Fan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san's powerful running...! No 
matter when or where I see it, it's just 
the best~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I am honored by your 
kind words.

text_block_list.name: McQueen's Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa~!

Mejiro McQueen's elegant smile as she said 
that sent the crowd's excitement soaring 
even higher.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-That was incredible... wasn't it, 
McQueen-san...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she possesses indisputable ability, 
and had an imposing, dignified presence 
befitting it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...C-Can I win, I wonder...

Rice Shower looked down timidly. It was 
right after witnessing such tremendous 
ability.
choice_data_list:
(To be honest, I can understand how they 
feel.)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, I want to "win."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...! Bourbon-san... You really do "want to 
win" after all...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... When I heard it yesterday, I 
was a bit surprised, you know? That you 
actually wanted to win.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Because up until now... it wasn't really 
like that."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... There has certainly been a 
change within me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The "stirring" I felt at the Kikuka Sho, 
and Rice-san's incredible spirit—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"For some reason, those memories have 
started to replay in my mind from time to 
time."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It took time for me to accept all of this, 
but now—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The feeling of "wanting to win" has become 
a definite source of power within me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: The race you ran... with Rice...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That's why I "want to win"... No, I 
*will* win.

As I marveled at her remarkable growth, 
Rice Shower gave a small nod as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So that's what happened.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Bourbon-san, Rice wants to win too. 
No, I *will* win...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"So, um, I'm counting on you at the Tenno 
Sho (Spring)...!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. I look forward to working with you.
—The next day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah!

Mihono Bourbon's running regained its 
stability.

It almost felt as though she had grown 
somewhat more powerful...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Lap time stabilization confirmed. 
Apologies for the 'commotion.'"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master, one more report—no, there is 
some 'small talk' I would like you to 
hear.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...This sensation of 'wanting to win' was 
'unpleasant' until I understood it, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, understanding it and surrendering 
myself to this passion feels "good."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...That concludes our "small talk." 
Transitioning to the next training 
session.

Heading into the Tenno Sho (Spring), 
Mihono Bourbon had gained a powerful new 
weapon.

Having grown one step further, she charged 
up the long uphill slope again today!
